title: Auteur: an agent skill that treats landing-page development like film direction
description:
Auteur is an agent skill that treats landing-page development like film direction, locking the art direction in a commit sheet before writing markup. It can scout references, generate assets, and build WebGL or scroll-driven scenes from recipes. Shipping is gated by executable checks: Slopscan rejects cliché styling and accessibility mistakes, while MotionQA measures dropped frames and browser errors. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/agiwhitelist/auteur
